title: Dodging along Stony Batter only Joe Hynes
html_source: Joe Hynes is one who “dodges” his debts. The narrator is a nasty debt collector. Hynes owes Bloom three pounds, but, since the narrator likes Hynes and despises Bloom, Hynes’s identity as a debt “dodger” is not a concern with him.

anchor.prefix: Arbour hill there and be damned but a bloody sweep came along and he near drove his gear into my eye. I turned around to let him have the weight of my tongue when who should I see

 — Lo, Joe, says I. How are you blowing? Did you see that bloody chimneysweep near shove my eye out with his brush?
